description: Recomputes the A=3 mu3 door under both the |chi| operator of #4404/#4657 and the bare chi, from identical braid words and identical y_lambda. Raw chi is negative on 15/30 blocks at n=9, so abs() is not a no-op and every Delta^2 conclusion in the arc was a priori at risk of being its artifact. Result: verdict robust (supermodular both ways, ~8% magnitude shift); per-block classification not robust.
caveats: The door VERDICT is robust to abs(); the PER-BLOCK classification of #4657 is not. abs() flips the sign of a substantial fraction of the 30 blocks at n=9 (count reported per isotope in results[*].n_negative_raw_chi, measured on the baseline word; it differs on the interface-carrying words), so the split of submodular pushes into 'Frechet-violating' vs 'negative-weight' is specific to the |chi| reading.
This probe does NOT derive which reading is correct. tr_M = sum y_lambda chi_lambda uses the bare character; the |chi| operator of #4404 is a modeling choice that remains underived.
